issues.issue: The Taxes line is split by fund column, not by a printed tax-type breakdown. 'Inheritance tax' is inferred from the fund name. That is plausible for a Nebraska county Inheritance fund, but it is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion Taxes 94,457; Visitor's Improvement Taxes 94,462; 911 Emergency Management Taxes 21,580
issues.issue: This is inconsistent with receipts[0]. The Inheritance fund's taxes were categorized by fund name, but the nonmajor Visitors Promotion/Improvement taxes (188,919, normally county lodging tax) were left unlabeled. Either approach can be defended, but both should be treated the same way.

issues.on_page: Misc. - General Government 3,514,867 (under the General Government heading)
issues.issue: The label and the schedule heading both say General Government. The line was recorded as culture/recreation because p4 prints General Fund Culture and Recreation 3,514,867. That is defensible, but the label and the category don't match.

Self-insurance fund receipts are probably premium contributions or reimbursements rather than true miscellaneous receipts. Nothing printed describes them, so 'other' with a review note is allowed but uncertain. The same applies to receipts[6] (1,619,327).

issues.on_page: Misc. - General Government 3,514,867 (p5) vs General Fund Culture and Recreation 3,514,867 (p4)
issues.issue: 'classification' is not one of the allowed check values (business, reconcile, balance, totals, detail).
